# Photo2Panning

Python library and CLI for photo motion, video processing, image editing,
local geometry reconstruction, and quantized models on Apple Silicon.

- [README](readme.md): Installation, public APIs, and runnable commands.
- [Tool guide](docs/agent-tools.md): Job selection, field meanings, validation,
  execution, and error handling for agents.
- [Local models](docs/models.md): Quantized FLUX, CPU segmentation, local
  LTX first/last frame video, and MoGe-2 scene reconstruction with Metal
  Gaussian rendering.
- [Repository instructions](AGENTS.md): Rules for changing this library.
- [Render job](examples/render.json): Photos, per-clip motion, and output size.
- [Scene job](examples/scene.json): Reconstruct the bundled public waterfall
  into a reusable Gaussian PLY and source-bound calibration JSON.
- [Camera job](examples/camera.json): Pan the same photo, pause for a 3D
  camera excursion, return to the paused composition, and resume.
- [Edit job](examples/edit.json): Ordered deterministic picture operations.
- [Generation job](examples/generate.json): Turn the bundled waterfall
  reference into a snowy winter scene with quantized FLUX 3.
- [Masked edit job](examples/generate-masked.json): Replace the sky selected
  by the mask job, retaining pixels outside its black-and-white PNG mask.
- [Abandoned-city job](examples/edit-empty-street.json): Edit a busy public
  street photo with FLUX 3, removing foreground pedestrians and traffic
  and adding signs of abandonment.
- [Video generation job](examples/generate-video.json): Local LTX camera
  transition between two independent Pexels views of Cloud Gate.
- [Mask job](examples/mask.json): Select the sky in the same public reference
  using Grounding DINO and SAM on the CPU.
- [Soundtrack example](examples/add_music.py): Replace a finished video's
  audio while copying its encoded video without recompression.

Get the authoritative JSON schema with `uv run pic2panning schema`.
Validate with `uv run pic2panning validate job.json` before execution.
Run a validated request with `uv run pic2panning run job.json`.
Call the Python API with the same validated request models when embedding.
Job kinds are render, scene, camera, edit, generate, generate-video, and mask.
Public API functions are render, reconstruct_scene, render_camera, edit,
generate, generate_video, mask, and run_job.
Image and mask models use the models extra; LTX uses the video extra.
Scene reconstruction and Gaussian camera rendering use the camera extra.
FLUX 3 can edit the entire reference image without a mask. With a mask, the
library composites its reference edit over the source. FLUX 1 Fill uses
the mask during generation. Black mask pixels retain source pixels exactly
in the final PNG; the cyan README overlay is a display of the selection.
For the bundled edit workflow, run examples/generate.json for the winter
edit, or examples/mask.json then examples/generate-masked.json for the sky.
The paired sky requests use the same 768 by 512 reference dimensions.
For the abandoned-city workflow, run examples/edit-empty-street.json.
It uses FLUX 3 reference editing without a mask and can change the whole
image. Two small distant vehicles remain; inspect outputs before claiming
complete removal. For masked workflows, padding expands selections along
each axis, from 0 to 128 pixels
(default 0), before saving or merging. The CLI flag is --padding. Inspect
the prepared mask for missed edges and shadows; black pixels outside that
mask retain the original in the final PNG.
Scene requests require source, output (.ply), and metadata (.json), with
explicit mps or cpu execution and a 1200 to 3600 token budget (default 1800).
max_edge limits the geometry image to 256 to 4096 pixels on its longest
edge (default 1920), while retaining the original photo for panning.
SceneResult returns output, metadata, points, source_sha256, and predictor.
Camera requests require source, scene, metadata, and output (.mp4). They
verify source identity before rendering. PLY and calibration can be reused
for different motion settings. Camera jobs return the ordinary JobResult.
Generated video is silent. Endpoint guides influence generation without
promising identical input pixels in the output.
Use views with shared geometry for a camera transition. A prompt does not
guarantee a geometric morph between unrelated scenes; inspect all frames
for cuts, dissolves, invented objects, and unstable geometry before
accepting an output.
